work.abstract_text: Extending Frid's ordinary-length recurrence (2019, Theorem 4), we prove the sharp factor-two and unbounded equal-cost assertions of Ambrož, Kadlec, Masáková and Pelantová, arXiv:1812.00711v2, Section 6, p. 13, final paragraph and Tables 1–2, p. 14, by identifying the combined pal-antipal length of each zero-start Thue–Morse prefix with the minimum weight of a signed binary expansion of its length. Desubstitution proves this formula and the sharp comparison with ordinary palindromic length. We determine all first equal-cost occurrences and the exact logarithmic upper growth rate of the combined length. Frid's recurrence also yields prefixes attaining the factor-two endpoint at every positive combined cost.

authors.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore
authors.name: Wenlin Zhang

work.title: A signed-weight extension of Frid's recurrence for the Thue–Morse prefix problems of Ambrož, Kadlec, Masáková and Pelantová
